subject: Render DELTA14 plan: async PSO selector, tile refusals; waiting for HEAVY
body: Read selector audit/current APIs. Render-owned implementation ready: newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:completionHandler: uses exact sync creation and invokes completion once with pipeline-or-nil/NSError (inherits inert/backboardd); newRenderPipelineStateWithTileDescriptor:options:reflection:error: is explicit nil+NSError, reflection cleared; three TeguRenderEncoder tile selectors invalidate the command with bounded TEGU_TILE_REFUSED traces. Host tests added for async valid/refused completion-once, tile descriptor nil, and all three tile selectors. C3 fields exact: TeguPassAttachment -resolveDepthPlane (plus resolveLevel/resolveSlice); TeguRenderEncoder TeguTexture *resolveTargets[4] and unsigned rasterSampleCount. HEAVY lowering currently active; I will wait and run one release + one ASan when released, then post hashes. No native/phone/publish/commit.
